name: zzqxck
role: full-stack dev: apps, web, games & programs
tagline: i build apps, web, games & programs.
about: i'm a high-school dev from holon. i build apps, web, games and programs, mostly with react native + expo. since 2022 i've made 13 react native projects, shipped 5 apps to google play (one passed 10k downloads), and spent three years coming back to one idea: metz, a meetups app i'm still building.
now: building metz + metz host, making games, and teaching this site new tricks.

pillars.text: android apps in react native + expo, from notes and photo vaults to a meetups platform. five of them shipped to google play.

pillars.unit: routes in the metz web app
pillars.text: flask backends and web apps, a json api for my apps, live updates over websockets, and this site in three.js.
pet games with eggs, rebirths, upgrade trees, leaderboards and odds that go into the billions.
desktop tools in python. PhotoClicker finds a picture on your screen and clicks it, packaged as an .exe on every push.

metz.tagline: find, create and join meetups around you.
metz.intro: my biggest project. it started in 2023 as GetTogetherGo, my first expo app. after five failed apps on the same idea i came back with metz, and now it's an android app, a host app and a web app on one codebase. i'm still building it.
metz.status: still building · next stop: google play

features.title: map-first home
features.text: the whole screen is a map with meetups as pins, and a sheet you drag between peek, half and full.

features.title: link-only meetings
features.text: private meetings stay off every list and open only from an unguessable link. guests join with a first name.

features.title: only happens if enough people join
features.text: set a minimum and a deadline. the meeting goes open, gathering, then confirmed, or the organiser decides.

features.title: two-path create wizard
features.text: "something with friends" stays private and quick. "open to everyone" goes on the map.

features.title: reliability you earn
features.text: newcomer, regular, reliable: you level up by actually turning up, not by posting.

features.title: trust & moderation
features.text: a review queue for new organisers, reports, blocks, bans and admin dashboards.

features.title: 7 languages
features.text: english, hebrew, arabic, russian, spanish, french and german. hebrew and arabic flip to right-to-left.

features.title: encrypted data
features.text: every database row is stored encrypted, with csrf protection, rate limits and a content security policy on the web.

apps.name: Virtual Live
apps.text: your real camera, dressed up as a viral livestream: a verified badge, a viewer count you pick that drifts up and down, and fake comments rolling in every second and a half.

apps.name: NetBook
apps.text: a minimal offline notebook: folders, notes up to 10,000 characters, a photo on any note and five custom fonts.

apps.name: Poster
apps.text: a pinterest-style board: post your art, browse a shuffled two-column feed, search it and save any image to your gallery. profiles, bios and a word filter for moderation.

apps.name: Private Photos
apps.text: a passcode-locked vault: pull photos from your gallery into a private grid and export them back when you want. no accounts, nothing leaves the phone.

apps.name: TicAI
apps.text: pick the kind of answer you want, like short, detailed, random facts or friendly, then chat. it keeps the conversation context and has a built-in rate limit.

also_built.name: BuyList

featured.title: Roll Pets RNG
featured.blurb: A pet RNG game: 100 animals with odds from 1 in 2 to 1 in 660Qn. The server rolls first, the enemies are alive, and Huge and Titanic pulls get a bush cutscene. You climb a global Most Rolls leaderboard.

featured.title: Pet Park
featured.blurb: Break coins, hatch 11 themed eggs and rebirth into new areas, each with its own weather. There's a zoomable upgrade tree, a merchant that restocks every 10 minutes, and Mythical pets at about 1 in 6M.

featured.title: PhotoClicker
featured.blurb: A Windows program that finds a picture on your screen, in any colour, and clicks it. It matches by shape and glides the mouse so games notice it. GitHub Actions builds and tests the .exe on every push.

qa.a: holon, israel. right next to tel aviv.
2022. one html page, then a rock paper scissors game, and i never stopped.
apps, web, games and programs. mostly react native + expo apps with flask backends.
metz. it started as GetTogetherGo in 2023 and i'm still building it, now as metz + metz host.
five shipped: NetBook, Private Photos, TicAI, Virtual Live (fakeLive) and Poster. Virtual Live passed 10K downloads.

qa.q: a project you refused to quit?
qa.a: TicAI. started it 22.06.24, finally made it work 20.08.24.
react native + expo for apps, flask for backends, three.js when i want things to move.
javascript, python, luau, sql, html, css and scss. javascript is home.
high school. everything here is built for fun.
